create_DatasetDescriptor: create a DatasetDescriptor dataclass to define dataset namespace, tablename, partitions, and vector count for FAISS benchmarks
create_CodecDescriptor: create a CodecDescriptor dataclass to configure a FAISS codec with factory string, construction params, and training vectors
create_IndexDescriptor: create an IndexDescriptor dataclass to describe a FAISS index by combining a codec descriptor and database descriptor
create_KnnDescriptor: create a KnnDescriptor dataclass to configure k-NN search parameters including index, query dataset, k value, and search params
run_DatasetDescriptor_k_means: run k-means clustering on a DatasetDescriptor to compute centroids using FAISS Kmeans with GPU support
